papers.title: When One Leak Pays Forever: Context Binding and the Price of Deterring Collusion
papers.titleZh: 一次泄露永久获利：上下文绑定与遏制共谋的代价
papers.abstract: A coalition that deviates once can profit many times when what it sells keeps working. In a threshold-encrypted mempool, a leading defense against maximal extractable value (MEV), a quorum of the decryption committee that sells its decryption capability to a front-runner exposes every later block that the capability still decrypts. We ask how large a penalty, such as slashable stake, deters this kind of collusion. In our repeated game, a single leak by any coalition in a monotone family of authorized coalitions (for example, any $k$ of the $n$ committee members) unlocks a set of future rounds, costs a one-time penalty, and ends the coalition's participation. We show that every dynamic deviation reduces to choosing a leak time, so deterrence holds if and only if each coalition's penalty covers the largest discounted value that a single leak reaches. Without discounting, over $T$ rounds of unit value full reuse needs a penalty of $T$ while binding each leak to its own round needs $1$, so no penalty that is constant in the horizon deters unbounded reuse; a reuse window of $w$ rounds costs at most $w$ times the largest per-round value. The cheapest profile of per-party stakes that deters every coalition solves a covering linear program. For blockchain design, per-epoch keys cut the required stake from the value of a key's lifetime to the value of one epoch; we calibrate the gap on Ethereum front-running data and place Ferveo and Shutter in the model. The analysis extends to sealed-bid auctions, multi-authority voting, and federated learning under a shared key.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么一次泄密可能带来长期收益？论文关注的是在重复交互中，一个联盟通过出售解密能力仅需行动一次，却能让买家持续获取未来多轮敏感信息。这种‘一次泄露、永久获利’的现象使得传统基于单次行为的威慑定价失效。文章旨在回答：需要多大的惩罚（如质押金）才能有效阻止这类跨期共谋，尤其是在门限加密内存池等区块链隐私保护机制中。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个重复博弈模型，其中n个参与方共同持有解密能力，授权联盟（如任意k方）可联合泄露解密密钥。每次泄露公开且终结该联盟的参与资格。模型核心是‘可达性集合’Rs(t)，表示在第t轮泄露后，买家能访问哪些后续轮次的数据。惩罚K(S)为一次性成本（如被罚没的质押），目标是判断诚实执行是否构成联盟安全的均衡。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文给出了精确的威慑阈值：联盟S被遏制当且仅当其惩罚K(S)不低于所有可能泄露时刻t中，其所能触及的未来收益的最高折现值。特别地，若解密能力长期有效，所需惩罚随时间线性增长；而若采用上下文绑定使每次泄露仅限于当前轮，则惩罚仅为单轮价值。这揭示了重用能力对威慑成本的根本影响。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 关键在于将动态偏离简化为选择最优泄露时机的问题。由于泄露是不可逆的终局行为，任何偏离的价值完全由其首次泄露所触发的可达轮次决定。因此，重复博弈的动态性被压缩为对可达性集合的静态最优化。通过分析不同密钥设计下的可达结构，并结合折现求和与覆盖线性规划，得出了紧确的威慑条件。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设泄露即终结参与且效用可转移，未考虑追踪失败或多次泄露的情形。结果高度依赖于可达性集合的设定，对现实系统参数敏感。尽管如此，论文提供了清晰的理论框架来量化安全代价，尤其适合评估Ferveo、Shutter等系统的经济安全性。最值得读的是其将时间维度引入共谋威慑的建模视角与紧确分析。

papers.title: The Power of Simple Mechanisms: A Tight $e$-Approximation for Gains from Trade in Matching Markets
papers.titleZh: 简单机制的力量：匹配市场中贸易收益的紧 e-近似
papers.abstract: We study how well simple mechanisms approximate gains from trade (GFT) in two-sided matching markets with independent buyer values and seller costs, where feasible outcomes form an arbitrary downward-closed family of matchings. This model includes bilateral trade and double auctions as special cases. We focus on the Generalized Random-Offerer (GRO) mechanism, which is an equal mixture of the Generalized Sellers-Offering Mechanism (GSOM) and the Generalized Buyers-Offering Mechanism (GBOM). We determine GRO's exact worst-case approximation ratio with respect to first-best GFT, showing that it is $e$. This improves the previous $3.15$ approximation guarantee (Babaioff et al. STOC 2026) for the same mechanism. In bilateral trade, the result implies a $1/e$ guarantee for the random-offerer mechanism, improving the previous $1/π$ bound (Jo 2026). Our analysis uses a two-dimensional inequality in quantile space to compare first-best GFT with optimal one-sided auction profits. For each potential trade, we identify the region of buyer values and seller costs for which the first-best allocation selects that trade, and then randomly shrink this region in quantile space, yielding posted-price rules whose expected profits can be evaluated exactly. We establish tightness of the $e$ approximation by constructing markets with regular type distributions, pairwise disjoint trading edges, and a single knapsack constraint. On these instances, GRO's expected GFT approaches a $1/e$ fraction of first-best GFT, therefore ruling out any better guarantee even under these restrictions.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在双侧市场中，由于买卖双方私有估值导致信息不对称，实现最大贸易收益（GFT）面临激励相容、个体理性与预算平衡之间的根本冲突。经典Myerson-Satterthwaite定理表明，即使在双边交易中也无法达到第一优效率。本文聚焦于一个长期开放的问题：简单机制在一般匹配市场中能以多高精度逼近第一优GFT，特别是广义随机提议者（GRO）机制的最坏情况性能此前尚未精确刻画。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个两方匹配市场，包含多个独立估值的买家和卖家，可行交易构成任意下闭合族的匹配结构，涵盖双边交易与双重拍卖等特例。每个买家有私有估值，卖家有私有成本，机制需满足主导策略激励相容、事后个体理性与事前弱预算平衡。研究对象是GRO机制，即以相等概率运行广义卖方出价（GSOM）或买方出价（GBOM）机制，二者均基于铁化虚拟价值最大化来分配。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文确定了GRO机制对第一优GFT的最坏情况近似比恰好为1/e，这是首个在一般下闭合匹配市场中的紧界结果。该结果改进了先前的1/3.15近似保证，并解决了该机制近似能力的长期开放问题。作为推论，在双边交易中随机提议者机制也获得1/e的紧保证，显著优于此前已知界限，揭示了简单机制在最坏情况下仍能保持常数比例的经济效率。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明采用‘单边利润’分析路径，通过在分位数空间中构造二维不等式，将第一优GFT与最优单边拍卖利润联系起来。核心技术是对每个潜在交易的选中区域进行随机收缩，生成可实现的定价规则，并利用积分恒等式精确计算其期望利润。通过将收缩后的水平与垂直截面定价规则以特定概率混合，证明其平均利润恰为原GFT的1/e，从而建立紧界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 紧性构造依赖全局背包约束与正则分布假设，尚不清楚在无额外约束的标准二分图匹配中是否仍可达1/e。此外，机制依赖共同已知分布，限制了完全贝叶斯环境下的适用性。尽管如此，论文的价值在于其精确刻画了简单机制的极限，提供了分位数空间下集合同调分析的新范式，其局部不等式与收缩技巧对后续双侧市场研究具有广泛借鉴意义。

papers.title: Sharp Second-Best Welfare in Bilateral and Matching Markets
papers.titleZh: 双边与匹配市场中的尖锐次优福利
papers.abstract: How much social welfare must a market lose because values are private? We determine the sharp ratio of second-best to first-best welfare under independent nonnegative types, Bayesian incentive compatibility, interim individual rationality, and no expected budget deficit. The ratio is approximately $0.8882516903$ for arbitrary priors and $0.9113893681$ when buyers have monotone hazard rates and sellers are unrestricted. The arbitrary-prior guarantee holds for every downward-closed family of feasible matchings; the MHR guarantee holds when every matching of a compatibility graph is feasible. Both constants are \revise{attained}{sharp} already in bilateral trade. The proof keeps the sellers' initial endowment inside the budget Lagrangian. For arbitrary priors, a common threshold decomposition reduces the problem to three-parameter power-law distributions. For monotone hazards, common transformations of buyer and seller scores reduce it to shifted capped exponential buyers; a typewise allocation certificate and an explicit worst-case seller satisfy the same boundary equation. The bilateral-to-matching framework, with a welfare endowment charge and an MHR-preserving packing argument, transfers these affine inequalities without loss. We give exact variational characterizations of both constants and reproducible interval certificates for their numerical evaluation. Unrestricted signed transfers also permit pointwise strong budget balance.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么私有价值会导致市场效率损失？该问题源于Myerson-Satterthwaite定理指出，在双边贸易中，激励相容、个体理性与预算平衡无法同时满足，导致无法实现完全有效交易。本文聚焦于在这些约束下，社会总福利（含卖方初始价值）的次优水平与第一最优之间的比率，追问这一效率损失的极限究竟有多高。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个双边或匹配市场，买方和卖方拥有独立非负的私有价值，卖方初始持有物品。机制需满足贝叶斯激励相容、事前个体理性且无期望赤字。目标是最大化期望社会福利，即卖方初始价值与交易带来的增益之和。研究对比了任意先验分布与买方具单调失效率（MHR）两类情形。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文确定了次优福利相对于第一最优福利的尖锐下界比率。对于任意独立先验，该比率为约0.88825；当买方具MHR性质时，提升至约0.91139。这两个常数是紧的，且已在最简单的双边贸易场景中达到。结果表明，即使在复杂匹配市场中，这一效率保证也不会下降。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过预算对偶方法将福利问题转化为带拉格朗日乘子的仿射不等式，并利用得分重构与共同分解技术，将一般分布归约到幂律分布或截断指数分布等极值情形。关键创新在于保持卖方初始价值项参与整个对偶分析，并设计了类型层面的福利证书与边界方程来同步构造下界与上界实例。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文假设类型独立且机制仅需事前预算平衡，排除了相关类型或事后平衡等更严格情形。其价值在于提供了福利视角下的精确刻画，而非仅关注交易增益。最值得阅读的是其统一的对偶框架、极值分布的构造逻辑以及将双边结果无损推广至匹配市场的‘提升’方法。

papers.title: Strategyproof Multi-Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing via Adaptive-Speed Fairness
papers.titleZh: 通过自适应速度公平性实现云计算中的策略证明多资源分配
papers.abstract: We study fair and strategy-proof allocation of multiple divisible resources with Leontief utilities, motivated by cloud computing. The canonical mechanism, Dominant Resource Fairness (DRF), satisfies sharing incentive (SI), envy-freeness (EF), strategy-proofness (SP), and Pareto optimality (PO), but can be highly inefficient in terms of utilitarian social welfare. Under the classical approximation benchmark, no mechanism satisfying even one of SI, EF, and SP can improve on the trivial worst-case guarantee. We therefore adopt the recently introduced \emph{fair-ratio} benchmark, which compares a mechanism only with the welfare-maximizing allocation that itself satisfies SI and EF. For two resources, we introduce Adaptive-Speed Fairness (ASF), a unified parametric framework that captures previous mechanisms as special or boundary cases. Every ASF mechanism satisfies SI, EF, and PO, and we derive a general sufficient condition that guarantees SP. Optimizing within this framework yields a strategy-proof mechanism with asymptotic fair-ratio $2/(2\sqrt2-1)\approx1.09384$, substantially improving the previous best guarantee $3-\sqrt{3} \approx 1.268$. We complement this upper bound with a lower bound of $1.07894$ for all ASF mechanisms, showing that our best mechanism is close to optimal within this framework. Experiments on synthetic and Google trace-generated instances support the theory and demonstrate strong empirical performance. Finally, we establish a sharp dimensional boundary. For the general setting with $m\ge3$ resources, every mechanism satisfying SI and SP has fair-ratio exactly $m$. The same factor-$m$ lower bound continues to hold for randomized mechanisms satisfying ex-post SI and truthfulness in expectation.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么现有公平机制在效率上表现不佳？论文指出，经典机制DRF虽满足公平与激励兼容，但在功利主义福利上可能损失因子m。传统基准下无法改进，因此作者采用新的fair-ratio基准，聚焦于在保持SI和EF的前提下提升效率，探索是否存在更优的策略证明机制。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者考虑多代理对多种可分资源的需求，每个代理具有Leontief效用函数，即资源需按固定比例使用。机制需分配资源以满足共享激励（SI）、无嫉妒（EF）、帕累托最优（PO）和策略证明（SP）。模型关注两资源情形，并引入状态变量如群体不平衡参数和剩余资源比来指导分配动态。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了自适应速度公平性（ASF）框架，统一了以往机制，并设计出ASF2机制，在两资源情形下实现了约1.09384的渐近fair-ratio，显著优于此前最优的1.268。同时证明对于三及以上资源，任何满足SI和SP的机制fair-ratio必为m，建立了紧确界。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造一个两步分配框架：第一步给予基线SI分配，第二步根据自适应速度比分配剩余资源。关键技术在于设计满足单调性和策略证明条件的速度函数，并利用水填充（water-filling）方式实现组内公平增长。分析中结合了比较引理与极限实例构造来推导上下界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: ASF框架依赖特定状态信息，且高维不可能性结果表明其优势局限于两资源场景。机制实现复杂度较高，实际部署需权衡。但论文在机制设计理念、tight分析与AI辅助发现方面极具启发性，值得细读其模型抽象、核心定理证明及对未来方向的讨论。

papers.title: Learning to Harvest Without Collapse in a Regenerative Commons: A Lagrangian Framework
papers.titleZh: 学习在再生公地中共生收获：一种拉格朗日框架
papers.abstract: The tragedy of the commons poses a multi-agent safety problem: reward-seeking agents can deplete a shared resource, and cooperation among its users does not itself specify how much must be preserved. We make preservation an explicit requirement by formulating a regenerative commons as a constrained Markov game or a constrained multi-agent MDP with a designer-specified depletion budget. We develop a nonstationary Lagrangian framework that constructs a policy sequence from solutions of unconstrained games or cooperative control problems. Extending earlier time-average constructions, we introduce average-epoch solution concepts for reset episodes with discounted rewards and terminal costs. We prove a reward-independent feasibility certificate, cooperative feasibility and approximate optimality against feasible policy mixtures, and an extension to unbiased sampled costs. For self-interested agents, a constrained Nash certificate quantifies the price-dispersion term introduced by deviations that redistribute budget across epochs. Under the stated assumptions on solver accuracy and multiplier updates, these results give constrained policy-sequence guarantees using solutions of unconstrained problems. Experiments with constrained IPPO and MAPPO in a Gordon-Schaefer fishery examine how depletion budgets shape stock retention, harvest rewards, and price adaptation.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 论文关注公共资源过度开发的风险，即‘公地悲剧’：个体追求收益可能导致集体资源枯竭。传统合作机制无法明确资源保护的具体程度。本文提出将资源保存设为显式约束，通过设定允许的最大耗尽量（耗尽预算），使保护目标量化，并研究在多智能体学习中如何满足该生态要求。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型基于一个再生渔业环境，多个采集者在共享生物量下进行多轮决策。每个回合从满载开始，经历固定步数后重置。系统引入耗尽预算约束，要求平均终端资源不低于阈值。采用受限马尔可夫博弈（CMG）与受限多智能体MDP（CM-MDP）分别建模自利与协作场景，并定义平均回合解概念来评估非平稳策略序列的表现。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了非平稳拉格朗日策略序列框架，通过动态调整共享乘子引导策略演化。理论上证明了该框架能提供可行性证书、合作下的近似最优性及博弈情形中的受限纳什证书。实验显示，在不同预算下，IPPO与MAPPO可通过价格反馈调节收获行为，实现接近目标的资源保留。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是利用无约束求解器迭代生成策略，并通过乘子更新反馈资源使用情况。采用平均回合准则结合折扣奖励与终端成本，扩展了传统的对偶次梯度分析。关键技术包括对偶能量引理控制乘子增长、偏差项分析处理价格波动影响，以及采样成本下的几乎必然可行性证明。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 理论依赖理想求解器与精确成本观测，而实验采用PPO与PI反馈，存在实现差距。均匀单边Slater条件在环境中不成立，限制了纳什稳定性保证。尽管如此，论文清晰展示了如何将生态约束融入多智能体学习，其拉格朗日框架与策略序列思想对安全与可持续AI具指导意义。

papers.title: RAVEN: Receiver-Conditioned Action-Value Encoding for Finite-Alphabet Multi-Agent Communication
papers.titleZh: RAVEN: 面向有限字母表多智能体通信的接收者条件动作值编码
papers.abstract: A message drawn from a small alphabet helps a teammate only if it keeps the distinctions that change that teammate's next decision. We show that scoring messages by action values averaged over the receiver's situation can erase exactly these distinctions, and we propose RAVEN (Receiver-conditioned Action-Value ENcoding), which trains a four-symbol, one-step-delayed channel to preserve each receiver's centered action-value profile within the receiver's own context. The sender never needs to know that context: the receiver decodes every symbol with its private information. We give two estimators of this target. With a teacher, offline RAVEN selects the codebook that exactly minimizes an empirical conditional distortion and distills it into a frozen sender; we bound the resulting codebook-selection error and one-step decision loss. Without a teacher, online RAVEN aligns, inside a QMIX learner, the deployed symbol pathway with a training-only continuous reference that shares its routing. Against five recent communication methods on eight navigation settings, offline RAVEN attains the highest return in seven, and removing receiver conditioning forfeits 83% of its communication gain. Online RAVEN raises predator-prey capture success from 53.2% to 96.0% over the same QMIX backbone without communication, and on SMAC and MPE it attains the best mean normalized score of 14 methods, including methods that exchange kilobit messages. Every RAVEN message costs 2 bits, 12-1,024x fewer than those of NDQ, CACOM and ExpoComm on navigation.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在多智能体协作中，通信常受限于极窄带宽（如仅2比特），传统方法通过端到端训练传递连续消息或简单聚合观测，但难以确保发送的信息真正影响接收者的决策。关键问题是：在发送方无法获知接收方上下文的情况下，如何让极小的消息保留对接收者动作选择最关键的区分信息？现有基于平均动作值的方法会因上下文混合导致决策差异被抵消。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在部分可观测环境中，多个智能体通过单步延迟、四符号（2比特）广播通道进行协作的任务。输入是各智能体的局部观测与历史，输出是离散通信符号及动作。模型评估基于团队累积回报，并在导航、捕食-被捕食、星际争霸（SMAC）和多智能体粒子环境（MPE）等多个基准上测试，强调通信效率与决策增益的权衡。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出RAVEN方法，其核心贡献在于定义了接收者条件下的动作值轮廓作为通信目标，并据此构建两种估计器。实验表明，在相同带宽下，RAVEN显著优于五种近期通信方法，在八项任务中七项取得最高回报，且通信开销仅为对比方法的1/12至1/1024。消融实验证明接收者条件机制贡献了83%的增益。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: RAVEN的关键机制是让每个符号编码在接收者特定条件下其动作值的中心化差异，而非全局平均值。离线版本利用教师网络构建条件动作值表，枚举最优四符号码本并固化发送方；在线版本则在QMIX框架内引入一个仅用于训练的连续参考路径，通过对其与离散通路的动作值轮廓对齐来实现无监督学习，从而避免梯度偏差。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文局限在于六智能体环形任务中表现不及CACOM和ExpoComm，且在线版本参数量高于部分基线，优势主要集中于带宽而非模型大小。结论可靠性高，因有充分消融与诊断分析支持。最值得读的是其‘接收者条件’机制设计与两种实现范式，为低带宽多智能体通信提供了新的原则性思路。

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Geometric Safety Certificates for Nonholonomic Robots Against Maneuvering Obstacles
papers.titleZh: 针对非完整机器人对抗机动障碍物的鲁棒几何安全证书
papers.abstract: Safe navigation against obstacles that can actively maneuver within bounded capabilities remains challenging: robust control barrier function methods typically treat obstacle actions as generic disturbances, while differential-game approaches are computationally expensive for online navigation. We propose an adversarially robust geometric certificate that accounts for the worst-case effect of admissible obstacle maneuvers directly in the safe-set geometry through a closed-form contraction of the certificate parameters. The construction exploits a structural property of line-of-sight (LoS) certificates: the robot and obstacle actions enter the certificate through a common state-dependent geometric gain. This gain cancels in the worst-case comparison, reducing the differential game to a direct comparison between obstacle maneuvering capability and the weaker of the robot's longitudinal and steering authorities. Instantiated on the parabolic certificate, the construction yields Adversarially Robust Dynamic Parabolic Control Barrier Functions (AR-DPCBF), for which we establish sufficient conditions for forward invariance of the contracted safe set against all admissible obstacle maneuvers under kinematic bicycle dynamics with bounded inputs. When the obstacle capability is unknown, a sliding-window estimator supplies a high-probability upper bound, allowing the guarantee to be retained with the corresponding coverage probability. We further formulate soft and buffered variants to recover feasibility in dense environments. Simulations across obstacle capabilities, densities, and capability mismatch show substantial reductions in barrier violations and collisions and demonstrate that pointwise robustification of the barrier derivative cannot substitute for contraction of its geometry.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 非完整机器人在动态环境中避障时，传统基于恒定速度假设的安全证书会因障碍物机动而失效，导致控制器误判安全状态。现有方法要么将障碍物动作视为通用扰动而过于保守，要么依赖计算昂贵的微分博弈。本文旨在建立一种能直接反映障碍物最坏机动影响的安全机制，在保持实时性的同时提供对抗性鲁棒保障。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为非完整自行车模型机器人在二维平面中导航，面对具备有界加速度和转向能力的机动障碍物。输入为机器人与障碍物的相对位置和速度，输出为安全控制指令。通过构建对抗性控制屏障函数（A-CBF），在闭环控制中实时评估并维持一个收缩后的安全集，并在仿真中对比不同障碍物能力、密度及估计误差下的碰撞率与约束可行性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了AR-DPCBF，一种闭式可计算的对抗性安全证书，其核心是通过对原始DPCBF参数进行几何收缩来显式保留最坏情况下的安全裕度。实验表明该方法显著减少安全违反和碰撞，且软化变体能在密集场景中恢复可行性。结果证实了几何收缩优于仅对导数进行点态鲁棒化的做法，提供了更强的安全保障。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法的关键在于发现机器人与障碍物动作在视线（LoS）坐标系下共享相同的几何增益因子，该因子在最坏情况比较中被抵消，从而将复杂的微分博弈简化为机器人控制权威与障碍物机动能力之间的标量比较。由此导出的闭式收缩规则直接作用于安全边界形状，而非瞬时导数，确保了前瞻性的安全保障。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于收缩条件较为保守，尤其在高对抗密度下可能导致QP不可行，且依赖于对障碍物能力的上界估计。尽管如此，论文的价值在于揭示了传统CBF在动态环境中的结构性缺陷，并提出了一种兼具理论严谨性与工程可行性的解决方案。最值得阅读的是其问题建模方式、几何收缩机制的设计思路及其与微分博弈的联系分析。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
papers.titleZh: 解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配
papers.abstract: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbors. For both classes, we establish feasibility conditions and finite-horizon convergence guarantees. We further derive a Wasserstein bound that characterizes the distributional deviation induced by the guidance. We demonstrate DeGG-Flow on multi-robot collaboration for crossing a spatial gap by reconfiguring the environment, and on multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements. Across both applications, DeGG-Flow directly generates objects that satisfy all corresponding hard requirements, including at team sizes unseen during training.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有生成模型虽能捕捉复杂分布，但难以保证生成结果满足硬性约束，尤其在多智能体场景中，团队级要求依赖多个智能体协同，而每个智能体又需独立决策。传统集中式引导依赖全局信息，违背去中心化原则，导致系统脆弱。本文旨在解决如何在不依赖其他智能体实时引导信号的前提下，仍能形式化保证团队级与个体级耦合约束的满足。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为多智能体流匹配框架，输入为任务条件（如初始状态、环境参数），输出为联合生成结果（如机器人策略或物体布局）。模型将生成过程建模为控制仿射动力系统，通过解耦引导机制在推理时动态调整各智能体的生成轨迹。实验在MuJoCo环境中测试多机器人协作越障与多物体场景生成，评估是否满足共享任务目标与私有可达性要求，并检验对未见团队规模的泛化能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出DeGG-Flow框架，首次实现了在多智能体生成中对耦合硬约束的形式化保障。核心贡献在于两类解耦引导机制——针对共享要求的SE引导与针对私有邻域依赖的PE引导，均具备可行性与有限时间收敛性证明。实验表明，在所有测试案例中（包括训练未见的团队规模），引导后生成结果100%满足硬性要求，显著优于无引导基线。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法将生成动力学视为受控系统，利用控制屏障函数思想设计解耦引导条件。SE引导通过自适应分配共享约束梯度，使各智能体独立计算本地输入却共同推动团队目标；PE引导则定义个体违规度并确保其有限时间收敛至零。理论推导建立了引导下的有限时间收敛性与Wasserstein分布偏移界，确保干预可控且结果可靠。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于引导依赖预设光滑约束函数，复杂语义要求需手动建模为几何条件，自动化程度受限。此外，理论假设连续控制输入，离散实现可能存在偏差。最值得阅读的是其系统框架设计与解耦机制，为安全关键型多智能体生成提供了可证明保障的新范式，尤其适用于无需重训练即可适应新约束的实际部署场景。

papers.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
papers.titleZh: 基于信息价值推理的辅助代理理性澄清
papers.abstract: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当用户向语言助手发出模糊请求时，助手应直接执行还是提问澄清？现有方法常依赖减少意图不确定性来决定是否提问，但忽略了澄清的成本、下游任务收益的变化，以及用户事后纠正的可能性。这导致在安全性和效率之间缺乏理性权衡，尤其在高成本交互或允许纠错的场景中表现不佳。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在两个任务上测试方法：一是模糊问答（CondAmbigQA），需从多义问题中识别正确语境并回答；二是偏好对齐的家庭任务规划（ADAPT），需根据隐藏偏好完成烹饪任务。通过模拟用户与奖励机制评估助手性能，衡量标准包括任务成功率、偏好满足率及提问次数，对比多种基线方法。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出REVOIR方法，能在无需训练的情况下，通过推理提问的‘信息价值’动态决策是否澄清。在ADAPT任务上，其偏好满足率比微调策略高出13-15%，提问量却仅为五分之一。在允许用户纠错的设置下，REVOIR能合理减少提问，显示其对交互成本的敏感性优于传统方法。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: REVOIR将澄清建模为合作博弈，维护关于用户意图的信念分布，并估算每个问题的‘信息价值’——即预期任务奖励提升减去提问成本。通过前向模拟提问后回答带来的信念更新与行动改进，结合成本调整，决定是否提问。该机制不依赖固定阈值或信息增益，而是任务导向的价值评估。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖单步价值估计，可能忽略长期信息积累效应；且未支持动作与提问的完全交错执行。实验基于模拟用户，真实人类交互可能存在偏差。最值得阅读的是其将信息价值引入大模型智能体决策的机制设计，以及在不同交互模式下的适应性实证分析。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination for Hospital Patient Flow Optimization
papers.titleZh: 基于物理信息的多智能体协同用于医院患者流优化
papers.abstract: Efficient patient flow coordination across autonomous hospital departments is critical for mitigating overcrowding and balancing resource utilization. While classical queueing theory, specifically open Baskett--Chandy--Muntz--Palacios (BCMP) networks, provides an interpretable mathematical topology for healthcare operations, analytical models rely on stationary assumptions and fixed routing matrices that degrade under state-dependent real-world dynamics. Conversely, centralized reinforcement learning approaches struggle to accommodate the decentralized structure of hospital governance, where individual clinical departments function with localized observations, heterogeneous resources, and divergent operational objectives. In this paper, we present a Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) framework titled \emph{Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination}, which embeds empirically calibrated BCMP queueing topologies as physical priors within a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture. Formulated as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) under coupled resource constraints, our method enables autonomous departmental agents to cooperatively negotiate patient routing and dynamic service scaling. To mitigate environmental non-stationarity without inducing excessive communication overhead, agents exchange localized action fingerprints along network edges and optimize a spatially decomposed reward structure. Empirical evaluations driven by real-world MIMIC-IV patient trajectories indicate that this cooperative multi-agent approach substantially reduces cumulative system delay compared to static Markovian approximations, heuristic dispatching, and independent multi-agent baselines, while maintaining clinical safety constraints.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 大型医院内部各科室自主运行，患者流动协调困难，易导致拥堵和资源失衡。传统排队模型依赖稳态假设，在动态现实中失效；集中式强化学习又难以适应科室间去中心化的管理结构。本文旨在解决如何在保持部门自治的同时，实现高效、安全的跨科患者调度。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究将医院建模为由多个临床单元构成的多智能体系统，每个科室作为独立智能体，基于本地状态（如床位占用、队列长度）做出决策。输入为局部观测与邻接科室的动作指纹，输出为服务加速与接收率调控动作。使用MIMIC-IV真实患者轨迹驱动仿真，并以系统总延迟为主要评估指标。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出一种融合BCMP排队网络作为物理先验的多智能体协同框架，使去中心化智能体能联合优化患者路由与服务能力。实验显示，相较静态模型、启发式调度及独立学习基线，该方法将系统累积延迟降低近两个数量级，且能稳定缓解非线性拥塞级联，验证了结构化协作的有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法通过嵌入校准后的BCMP网络提供拓扑结构与容量边界，指导多智能体强化学习。采用动作指纹沿拓扑边通信，缓解部分可观性与环境非平稳性；设计分层奖励分解机制，平衡局部效率与全局稳定性；并引入专家行为掩码，过滤临床上不可行的转移路径，确保策略安全性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型依赖历史均值设定基础服务能力，未考虑医护人员实时负荷波动对服务效率的影响。此外，专家掩码基于统计规律，可能限制罕见但合理的临床路径探索。最值得阅读的是其将经典排队理论与多智能体学习结合的系统设计理念及其对现实医疗协同的启示。
